en: Hi and welcome to this course. My name is
Maximilian Schwarzmüller and I will be your
instructor in this course where I will teach
you how to efficiently use AI tools like
GitHub Copilot and the Cursor IDE
as a developer. Because of course,
AI
is here, it's here to stay,
and as a developer, it's another powerful
tool in your tool belt which you can and
should use. But of course, in order to use
it, You must know how to use it. And whilst
getting started with it is simple,
it's also kind of simple to
use all these AI tools inefficiently, to
rely too much on them, or to simply not know
about certain features that would exist that
you're maybe not using.
And that's the purpose of this course. I'll
walk you through the most important features
offered by GitHub Copilot and Cursor. I'll
show you how you could sometimes also use
ChatGPT in addition to these tools and we'll
build a complete demo project with these
tools after learning about their essentials
so that by the end of this course, you'll be
able to use these tools as a developer
efficiently too. And that's also important.
This is not a no-code course. This is not a
course for people who don't know how to
write code because whilst AI can help you
there as well,
in my experience, it's not fully there yet
and it might never be.
Instead, at this point in time, in my
experience, the most powerful AI use case is
to use it in conjunction with your existing
development knowledge because it can make
you more efficient. And that's what this
course is about. So if you don't know
anything about writing code, this course
won't be for you. But if you do know
something about it, no matter which kind of
programming language you're using, This
course will hopefully teach you some new
tricks.
And therefore, let's not waste any time.
Let's dive right in and let's get started
with this course.
